data.name: Aube
data.gender_notes: Aube is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: In Greek mythology, Aube is the name of the goddess of dawn. She represents the beginning of a new day and the promise of a fresh start. In Christianity, Aube can symbolize the rising of the Son and the light of God. The name Aube carries the meaning “Dawn, Sunrise” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Aube usually hope their child will grow to embody dawn, sunrise and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes new beginnings, hope, and the light of God.
data.etymology: Aube belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Dawn, Sunrise.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Aube total 2, giving a life-path number of 2. Number 2 is linked with Moon and with the qualities of harmony, sensitivity and partnership.

in_hebrew.name: אובה
in_hebrew.long_meaning: השם אובה מקורו בשורש העברי 'אוב' שפירושו 'להיות אוורירי' או 'להאיר'. הוא קשור למושג של שחר חדש, תקווה ואור בבוקר. השם משקף את הרעיון של התחדשות ושינוי חיובי, ויכול לסמל התחלה חדשה ומלאת תקווה.

in_greek.name: Αυβ
in_greek.long_meaning: Το όνομα Αυβ συνδέεται με την ελληνική λέξη 'αυγή', που σημαίνει 'αύριο' ή 'νέα μέρα'. Στην πνευματική και πολιτιστική παράδοση της Ελλάδας, το όνομα αυτό μπορεί να συμβολίζει την ανανέωση, την ελπίδα και τη νέα αρχή. Η προέλευσή του συνδέεται με την ιδέα του φωτός και της αναγέννησης.

in_latin.name: Aube
in_latin.long_meaning: Nomen Aube derivatur ex Latinis verbis 'aurora' et 'novus dies', quae lucem et novitatem significant. In traditione Christiana, nomen hoc potest significare spem, renovationem et vitam aeternam. Est nomen quod inspirationem et lucem in tenebris portat.

in_english.name: Aube
in_english.long_meaning: The name Aube is derived from French, meaning 'dawn' or 'new day'. It originates from the Latin 'aurora', which symbolizes the break of day and new beginnings. In Christian tradition, the name Aube can signify hope, renewal, and spiritual awakening. It embodies the qualities of light, joy, and a fresh start. Historically, names related to natural phenomena like dawn have been used to signify spiritual rebirth and enlightenment.

data.spiritual_significance: The name 'Aube' holds profound spiritual significance in Christianity as it symbolizes the dawning of the Son and the light of God's love. It represents the hope of a new day, a fresh start, and a reminder of the promises of God. Additionally, the name can serve as a reminder of the power of God to bring light into the darkness and to provide the strength and courage to face each new day with faith and hope.
